summary: National Grid plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing routine UK regulatory announcements: a monthly voting rights update (Exhibit 99.1) and a notification of a major interest from BlackRock, Inc. (Exhibit 99.2). BlackRock disclosed a 8.58% total interest (8.39% voting rights + 0.19% via financial instruments) as of 1 June 2026, up from a previous 8.42%. The filing also includes standard Director/PDMR shareholding notices. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring event is present. This 6-K is a routine periodic report of a foreign private issuer, not a special situation.
